name: 124. Gemini Responses stream keeps signed inline images (#7342 / PR #7357) (gemini-signed-image-stream)
description: Gemini 3 image models attach a thoughtSignature to the same part as inlineData. processGeminiPart matched the standalone thoughtSignature case before the media cases, so the streamed /v1/responses path treated the part as a signature-only reasoning item and dropped the generated image (HTTP 200, image tokens billed, no image in the client response). PR #7357 processes media first and keeps the signature on the emitted content block. Each case only asserts the invariant when the model actually generated and billed an image in that run, since Gemini image generation is nondeterministic.
